details: Batch for Fri Nov 20 sent, waiting for approval
summary: In the last 7 days (Nov 13 to 19) 35 Trial Reels went out and 30 have numbers; the other 5 show no views in Metricool and are left out. The 30 drew 8,678 views in total, typically about 210 each. About 19% of viewers stayed past 3 seconds (18.9% across all views). That is down about 10 points on the days before (Nov 9 to 12, 18 reels, 28.7%), which used the older video template. In the current test, the author or explainer opening (O4) is ahead of the number-fact opening (O1) by 3.4 points after day 1, 18.4% over 332 views against 15.0% over 122 views, but only one O1 reel has numbers so far, so this is too small to mean anything yet. Best recent reel by 3-second hold: Kitab at-Tawhid, 25.9%. Worst: Commentary on the Three Fundamental Principles of Islam, 6.6%. Today's batch is day 2 of the same test: the author or explainer line against the number fact, with the openings swapped across the books.
